definitions.explanation: A furious, sustained attack, in war or, very often, in sports reporting.

examples.japanese: {猛攻|もうこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{仕掛|しか}ける→仕掛ける：04243_shikakeru⟧。
⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{猛攻|もうこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{耐|た}えた→耐える：12087_taeru⟧。
examples.english: We held out against the opponent's onslaught.

examples.japanese: ⟦{後半|こうはん}→後半：12555_kouhan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{猛攻|もうこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せて→見せる：01988_miseru⟧{三点|さんてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{奪|うば}った→奪う：01895_ubau⟧。
examples.english: In the second half the team went all out on the attack and scored three goals.

notes:
{猛|もう} (fierce) + {攻|こう} (attack). A favorite of sports headlines, where it means a burst of relentless attacking.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {猛攻|もうこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{仕掛|しか}ける→仕掛ける：04243_shikakeru⟧ / かける: to launch an all-out attack
- {猛攻|もうこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{浴|あ}びる→浴びる：02844_abiru⟧: to come under fierce attack
- {猛攻|もうこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{耐|た}える→耐える：12087_taeru⟧ / ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧しのぐ: to withstand an onslaught

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{攻撃|こうげき}→攻撃：02748_kougeki⟧: attack; the neutral word
- ⟦{猛烈|もうれつ}→猛烈：13490_mouretsu⟧: fierce, violent (an adjective)
